info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Product Management Discount Pricing-spec
info.description: The Product Management Discount Pricing API enables businesses to establish and manage discount pricing strategies for their products. This service provides the ability to create new discount pricing structures, allowing for flexible and competitive pricing adjustments. Typical users include product managers and pricing analysts who are looking to optimize sales through targeted discount initiatives. By utilizing this API, organizations can effectively respond to market changes and enhance their pricing agility.
